source_refs.note: Quantitative Analysis: a main subheading of 14.4 Simple Harmonic Motion and Uniform Circular Motion, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 26-26.

blocks.text: Ek particle P radius x₀ wale circle ke kinare (circumference) par uniform angular velocity ω se ghoom raha hai. P par us ki linear velocity tangent (circle ko chhoone wali line) ke saath hai: vₚ = rω (yahan r = x₀). Q, P ki projection hai jo diameter par mean position O ke gird jhoolti hai. Jab particle P par ho to Q, O se x faasle par hota hai.
